author: pm
body:
The new CControls core sidecar is just over the limit; split further or trim.

**Done when:** core.md is under 10 KB or kept whole with a dated reason.

Source: user request 2026-11-23 (d-026); .claude/docs/documentation.md.

**Closed, 2026-11-24:** decisions.md went from 15,101 B to a 5,292 B index over six topic sidecars in `.claude/docs/decisions/` (1.7-3.5 KB each). A script check found 30 `## d-` headings before and after with the same ids, and every original line verbatim. `.gitignore` now whitelists the sidecars. ccontrols-reference/core.md (11,042 B) is kept whole with a dated assessment, as allowed by d-026.
